requirements.topic_heading: Hazards, Safety Gear & First Aid in Action Sports
requirements.req_text: Do the following: (a) Explain to your counselor the most likely hazards you may encounter while participating in action sports (skateboarding or snowboarding) and what you should do to anticipate, help prevent, mitigate, and respond to these hazards. (b) Review prevention, symptoms, and first-aid treatment for hypothermia, frostbite, dehydration, sunburn, heat exhaustion, heatstroke, blisters, sprains, strains, fractures, head/concussion injuries, and spinal injuries. (c) Show your helmet, wrist guards, knee/elbow pads, boots, and bindings, and explain how to inspect and fit them properly.

pamphlet_excerpts: Action Sports Sub-Req 5a: Demonstrate three intermediate maneuvers or tricks approved by your counselor in a supervised skatepark or snow terrain park.
Action Sports Sub-Req 5b: Explain Leave No Trace and outdoor stewardship principles at mountain resorts and community skateparks, and explore careers or volunteer roles (such as National Ski.
Core Standard 1 (Req 5): (a) Demonstrate three intermediate maneuvers or tricks approved by your counselor in a supervised skatepark or snow terrain park.
Core Standard 2 (Req 5): (b) Explain Leave No Trace and outdoor stewardship principles at mountain resorts and community skateparks, and explore careers or volunteer roles.
step_by_step_procedure: Step 1 - Review Standard (Req 5): Read the official Action Sports requirement and identify the key questions, terms, or skills covered in Leave No Trace & Outdoor Ethics.
Step 2 - Gather Evidence & Examples: Research the required facts in the Action Sports Pamphlet and record structured notes in your Scout Workbook.
Step 3 - Practice & Apply (Demonstrate): Work with your patrol buddy or family (as required) to demonstrate each element of Leave No Trace & Outdoor Ethics with concrete real-world examples.
Step 4 - Counselor Conference & Sign-Off: Present your completed workbook organizer and demonstrate your understanding to your Merit Badge Counselor for Blue Card verification.
